review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 45 bytes, 17 instructions, 6 blocks, 8 edges; both decoders and the emitted candidate report 6/8, score 1.000.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: Block and edge counts match retail exactly (6/8), including the two exits: the mid-loop match return and the post-loop spin.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: One cdecl argument read from [esp+4] after four saved registers, compared against record+0x18; nothing else is read.

checks.name: call_and_error_path
checks.rationale: Debug_Error is called with the exact retail format bytes 'No files loaded at address: %p' and the argument forwarded as a pointer, then the routine spins at 0x004B1ABA with jmp $, which the transcription reproduces as an empty infinite loop.

checks.name: loop_shape
checks.rationale: Retail loads the current record's next pointer before comparing the record's own +0x18, so the walk entry and every continuation require a non-null next. The C++ keeps that ordering rather than rewriting it as a normal 'while (node)' walk.

checks.name: return_value
checks.rationale: The match path returns without loading EAX, so the transcription returns void; no return value is invented.

limitations: The head word 0x00943970 has no other owner in the tree, so this file defines it and it starts null; retail's head is populated elsewhere. The routine dereferences it without a null check exactly as retail does.

Because the next pointer must be non-null before a record is compared, the last record of an acyclic list is never examined. That is retail's observable shape and is transcribed rather than corrected; whether the real list is circular is unproven.
Record layout beyond +0x00 and +0x18 is not established; the middle is opaque padding rather than a described structure.
